description.zh: 项目名称，获取方式请参见[创建项目](~~478153~~)。
description.en: The name of the project. For more information, see [CreateProject](~~478153~~).
The URLs of the two images for compression.

descriptions.zh:
- **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解智能媒体管理产品的收费方式和[价格](~~88317~~)。**
- 对于输入的图片，只会选取图片中人脸框范围最大的人脸进行人脸比较。人脸框检测结果与[DetectImageFaces](~~478213~~)一致。
descriptions.en:
*   Before you call this operation, make sure that you are familiar with the [billing](~~88317~~) of Intelligent Media Management (IMM).****
*   For the input image, only the face with the largest face frame in the image is used for face comparison. The face frame detection result is consistent with the responses of the [DetectImageFaces](~~478213~~) operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun imm compare-image-faces --project-name test-project --credential-config example-string --source URI2=oss://test-bucket/test-object2 URI1=oss://test-bucket/test-object1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
